name: 島はリセット！ でもAIには「攻略メモ」がある(再制作版・最新仕様)

p_a4fd64d06b.sentence: But the fun at the heart of both is much the same: moving past “What is here?”
p_a4fd64d06b.prev: The other means putting moves together.
p_a4fd64d06b.next: and asking “What can I do with this?”

p_b9fdbf3f08.sentence: It is also about joining movements together.
p_b9fdbf3f08.prev: What matters is imagining a place as something else.
p_b9fdbf3f08.next: The star is how the AI played.

p_8aa37ed64c.sentence: The paper tells of one AI walking through a temple.
p_8aa37ed64c.prev: If we put those measures aside, we can see another kind of fun on the island.
p_8aa37ed64c.next: It went from the south gate, past a stone, and on to the altar.

p_54321e3560.sentence: It moved things, tried them out, and checked what happened.
p_54321e3560.next: The whole island is a giant toy box.
